about.contact.description: Contact line; keep the <mail></mail> tags around {email}

about.honor.defaultMessage: Anyone can post — we trust our neighbors. If spam shows up, we’ll add a neighborhood code or sign-in. Kids are welcome to help with a grown-up’s OK.
about.honor.description: Explains open posting and what happens if it is abused

about.how.fed.defaultMessage: Fed King? Tap “I fed King”, pick what he ate, and log it.

about.how.undo.defaultMessage: Made a mistake? You can undo for 10 minutes.

about.purpose.defaultMessage: This site helps us share the job: when he last ate, what he had, and where he was last seen — so nobody has to guess.

about.story.defaultMessage: King is an 11-year-old grey long-haired cat. His owner left him behind two years ago, so the neighbors on his street decided to look after him together.
about.story.description: King’s story, first paragraph of the About page

app.name.description: Site name shown in the header

app.unreachable.defaultMessage: Couldn’t reach King’s tracker. Check your connection and try again.
app.unreachable.description: Shown when the status cannot be loaded

feed.hint.defaultMessage: Tap everything he had. Not sure? Just log it.
feed.hint.description: Explains that several foods can be picked, or none

feed.log.description: Saves the feeding with the picked foods

footer.about.description: Footer link to the About page

footer.copyright.description: Copyright year for the site content

footer.credit.defaultMessage: Brought to you by King’s neighbors on Guy St.
footer.credit.description: Footer credit; Guy St. is the street name and stays as is

footer.privacy.description: Footer link to the Privacy page

footer.siteLinks.description: Accessible name for the footer link list

home.mood.contentDetail.description: Playful royal line under the content heading

home.photoAlt.defaultMessage: King, a fluffy grey long-haired cat

home.seenBy.description: Activity item; {name} is who saw King

home.tagline.defaultMessage: A whimsical, neighborly way to keep track of King, the 11-year-old long-hair our street co-parents. Who saw him, where, and when he last ate.
home.tagline.description: One-line explanation of the site under the header on the home page

logged.fed.detail.defaultMessage: King was fed just now. Thank you!

logged.seen.detail.defaultMessage: Everyone can see he was spotted just now.

logged.undoExpired.defaultMessage: It’s too late to undo — entries can only be undone for 10 minutes.
logged.undoExpired.description: Shown when the server refuses an undo because the entry is older than 10 minutes

page.backToKing.description: Link from About/Privacy back to the home page

privacy.intro.defaultMessage: We keep as little as possible.
privacy.intro.description: Opening line of the Privacy page

privacy.not.fonts.defaultMessage: Our fonts are hosted here, so visiting doesn’t contact Google.

privacy.not.ip.defaultMessage: Your internet address is used for about a minute to stop spam (it limits how often entries can be posted) and isn’t stored. We remove it from our technical logs.
privacy.not.ip.description: IP addresses: used briefly for rate limiting, stripped from telemetry

privacy.not.title.description: Heading over the list of things not collected

privacy.not.tracking.defaultMessage: No accounts, ads, trackers or cookies. We don’t ask for your name.
privacy.not.tracking.description: Not collected: accounts, ads, trackers, cookies, names

privacy.parents.defaultMessage: For parents: kids can help without sharing anything about themselves.
privacy.parents.description: Note for parents about children using the site

privacy.retention.defaultMessage: Entries are kept as King’s history. Want one removed? Email <mail>{email}</mail>.
privacy.retention.description: Retention and removal requests; keep the <mail></mail> tags around {email}

privacy.stored.code.defaultMessage: A random code saved in your browser, so you can undo your own entries. It isn’t linked to who you are.
privacy.stored.code.description: Stored data: the per-device undo key
